ad_group_name.comment: Ad group name. Character limit is 512 and cannot contain emoji.

frequency.name: frequency

frequency_schedule.name: frequency_schedule
frequency_schedule.comment: frequency, together with frequency, controls how often people see your ad (only available for REACH ads).

languages.name: languages

metadata.comment: Each record represents data for each ad group for each hour.

source_relation.name: source_relation
source_relation.comment: The source of the record if the unioning functionality is being used. If not this field will be empty.

cpc.name: cpc
cpc.comment: The average amount of money you've spent on a click.

cpm.name: cpm
cpm.comment: The average amount of money you've spent per 1,000 impressions.

ctr.name: ctr
ctr.comment: The percentage of times people saw your ad and performed a click.

impressions.name: impressions
impressions.comment: The number of times your ads were on screen.

clicks.name: clicks
clicks.comment: The number of clicks on your ads.

spend.name: spend
spend.comment: The estimated total amount of money you've spent on your campaign, ad group or ad during its schedule.

reach.name: reach
reach.comment: The number of unique users who saw your ads at least once. This metric is estimated.

conversion.name: conversion
conversion.comment: The number of times your ad achieved an outcome, based on the secondary goal you selected.   As one campaign may have a number of different secondary goals, this statistic is not supported for campaigns.  Please go to ad groups or ads to view. (The total count is calculated based on the time each ad impression occurred.)

cost_per_conversion.name: cost_per_conversion
cost_per_conversion.comment: The average amount of money you've spent on a conversion.  (The total count is calculated based on the time each ad impression occurred.)

conversion_rate.name: conversion_rate
conversion_rate.comment: The percentage of results you received out of all the clicks of your ads.   (The total count is calculated based on the time each ad impression occurred.)

likes.name: likes
likes.comment: The number of likes your video creative received within 1 day of a user seeing a paid ad.

comments.name: comments
comments.comment: The number of comments your video creative received within 1 day of a user seeing a paid ad.

shares.name: shares
shares.comment: The number of shares your video creative received within 1 day of a user seeing a paid ad.

profile_visits.name: profile_visits
profile_visits.comment: The number of profile visits the ad drove during the campaign. This metric is only for Boosted TikToks.

follows.name: follows
follows.comment: The number of new followers that were gained within 1 day of a user seeing a paid ad. This metric is only for Boosted TikToks.

video_play_actions.comment: The number of times your video starts to play. Replays will not be counted.

video_watched_2_s.name: video_watched_2_s
video_watched_2_s.comment: The number of times your video played for at least 2 seconds. Replays will not be counted.

video_watched_6_s.name: video_watched_6_s
video_watched_6_s.comment: The number of times your video played for at least 6 seconds, or completely played. Replays will not be counted.

video_views_p_25.name: video_views_p_25
video_views_p_25.comment: The number of times your video was played at 25% of its length. Replays will not be counted.

video_views_p_50.name: video_views_p_50
video_views_p_50.comment: The number of times your video was played at 50% of its length. Replays will not be counted.

video_views_p_75.name: video_views_p_75
video_views_p_75.comment: The number of times your video was played at 75% of its length. Replays will not be counted.

average_video_play.name: average_video_play
average_video_play.comment: The average time your video was played per single video view, including any time spent replaying the video.

average_video_play_per_user.name: average_video_play_per_user
average_video_play_per_user.comment: The average time per user your video was played per single video view, including any time spent replaying the video.

real_time_conversion.name: real_time_conversion
real_time_conversion.comment: Number of times your ad resulted in the optimization event you selected.

total_purchase_value.name: total_purchase_value
total_purchase_value.comment: The total value of purchase events that occurred in your app that were recorded by your measurement partner.

total_sales_lead_value.name: total_sales_lead_value
total_sales_lead_value.comment: The monetary worth or potential value assigned to a lead generated through ads.

stat_time_day.comment: The reporting date for the campaign data (in YYYY-MM-DD format).

clicks.name: clicks
clicks.comment: Total number of times users clicked on ads within the campaign.

impressions.name: impressions
impressions.comment: Total number of times ads in the campaign were shown.

spend.name: spend
spend.comment: Total amount spent for the campaign in the account currency.

conversion.name: conversion
conversion.comment: Number of attributed conversions from ads in the campaign based on the TikTok attribution model.

conversion_rate.name: conversion_rate
conversion_rate.comment: Ratio of conversions to impressions, calculated as conversions divided by impressions.

cost_per_conversion.name: cost_per_conversion
cost_per_conversion.comment: Average cost per conversion, calculated as total spend divided by conversions.

cpc.name: cpc
cpc.comment: Cost per click, calculated as spend divided by the number of clicks.

cpm.name: cpm
cpm.comment: Cost per thousand impressions, calculated as (spend / impressions) * 1000.

ctr.name: ctr
ctr.comment: Click-through rate, calculated as clicks divided by impressions.

real_time_conversion.name: real_time_conversion
real_time_conversion.comment: Number of real-time conversions tracked by TikTok.

source_relation.name: source_relation
source_relation.comment: The source of the record if the unioning functionality is being used. If not this field will be empty.

_fivetran_synced.comment: Timestamp indicating when the record was last synced.
